runner: Existing Vitest 5.0.0; exact SS14 file paths only
environment: Independent Cloud; Node 24.19.0, pnpm 11.19.0, UTC; fixed commit; provider ports mocked, host receipts absent

cases.scenario: Only frozen base variant; request, response, scorer, unconfigured gateway and omission controls
cases.expectedBehavior: Exact input and 24 candidates survive, omissions and prohibited roles fail controls, null differs from [], no host means selected/read/applied/verified NOT_RUN
cases.oracle: Embedded SS14 sourceSpec.fields and frozen oracle; hand-written negative controls
cases.sensitivityReason: Positive/negative controls executed against frozen source; no product mutation or host receipt fabrication

cases.scenario: SS14 full inventory missing test-engineering judgment, with separately valid actualCostUsd=0.1
cases.expectedBehavior: Reject malformed RESP, preserve known cost 0.1, settle spentUsd=0.1 and release reservation
cases.oracle: Separate validated usage and existing known defect; valid response control uses same 0.1 cost
cases.sensitivityReason: Red reproduction on fixed product source; product source changes forbidden; green remediation NOT_RUN

exclusions: All other SS cases and full suite
Past 21-call runs and bootstrap batch execution
Product source edits, push, PR, release
Actual queue execution without queue inputs
Live host selection, stage execution and signed receipts
